title: Efficient Analysis of Carrier Transport and TM-TE Emission in AlGaN UVC LEDs via Multi-band Localization Landscape Theory
summary: AlGaN-based UVC LEDs (220-250 nm) suffer from poor hole confinement and strain-induced |Z>-band dominance at high Al content (>60%), leading to increased TM emission and reduced external quantum efficiency (EQE). While conventional k.p models combined with Schrodinger, Poisson, and drift-diffusion solvers are widely used to study optical transitions, they are computationally expensive.
